Title: Jenkins plug-ins for Azure are being retired on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
Because the Azure command-line interface (Azure CLI) provides a more up-to-date and robust experience when accessing Azure services, we will retire Jenkins plug-ins for Azure on 29 February 2024. For more details, refer to this list of affected Jenkin plug-ins. 

Action required 

To avoid disruption to your current workloads, review the steps required to transition your pipeline scripts to Azure CLI. 

More information 

If you have any feedback or need technical help, please contact us at Jenkins plug-ins for Azure support.
